_comment: Wildreach sound table (WRSound.h has the event names; files are .ogg under Data/Audio, names without the extension). volume: 0..4 (the loudness match is already in it), pitch: [min, max], radius: cm (0 = 2D), category: effects / ui / ambient / music, minGap: seconds before the same event plays again on the same actor or spot, maxVoices: at once, duck: how far music dips under it. creatures: voice family and pitch per creature id. ambient: beds crossfaded by layer (volcanic, tundra, coast, day, night, volcanic.day/night, tundra.day/night, cave, lava, high, wind, always). music: pools (menu, explore, night, combat, boss) and timings in seconds. Rebuilt from the sources by Tools/audio (see Docs/CREDITS.md). Storm peaks adds layers storm_peaks / storm_peaks.day / storm_peaks.night / storm.<zone> (passes, cliffs, bridges, crags, shrines, rodfield, hollow) / weather.thunderstorm.storm_peaks, and pools explore/night/combat/mini/camp.storm_peaks, boss.kharvox, sub.monastery, sub.hollow_spire, layer.great_storm, pass.stormgut (Tools/audio/build_storm_audio.py). The Swamp adds layers swamp / swamp.day / swamp.night / swamp.<zone> (reeds, reeds.night, mangroves, boardwalks, pools, pools.night, bones) / swamp.falls / swamp.bleedwater / swamp.red_tide / swamp.coven, creature kinds tell and signature (creature.<family>.tell / .signature), and pools explore.swamp.a/b/c, night/combat/mini/camp.swamp, boss.mother_maw, boss.hex_warden, boss.bloat, boss.vharra.p1-p3, sub.sunken_coven, layer.red_tide (Tools/audio/build_swamp_audio.py). The Ancient forest adds layers forest.day / forest.night / forest.<zone> (meadows, meadows.day, streams, streams.night, villages, oldgrowth, canopy) / forest.hollow / forest.falls_near, and pools explore.forest.a/b/c, night/combat/mini/camp/village.forest, boss.old_gnarl, boss.bramblequeen, boss.grey_matron, boss.hornwarden, boss.sylvaroth.p1-p3, sub.hollow_root, layer.bloom, layer.wild_hunt (Tools/audio/build_forest_audio.py).

events._combatFull: cooks/build-combat-full.md: the final cue before a held strike (a bright ring), element reactions, a part breaking, the ground heaving before a burst, each status's proc. Built from the files already in Data/Audio (CREDITS.md).
events._survival: cooks/build-survival.md: lying down, waking Rested, a torch or lantern lit, put out and doused, a lightning strike's crackling warning and its crack. Built from the files already in Data/Audio (CREDITS.md).

events._hitLayers: A landed blow plays four layers (WRFxCombat.cpp, COMBAT-AND-LESSONS L1): hit.transient.<flesh|armor|stone> (the edge), hit.body.<light|heavy> (the weight; the heavy one ducks the music ~2 dB), the material (hit.flesh / hit.armor / hit.dust / frost.impact by what was hit, fx.json impacts) and the creature's hurt voice. Crits add crit.stab (4 dB duck), breaks stance.break / guard.break. Files from Tools/audio/make_combat_layers.py.

voiceFallback._comment: A creature call kind with no row of its own (creature.<id>.<kind> or the family's) plays another kind: [kind, pitch, volume] (cooks/cookpass-creatures.md 3.4). alert = the alarm as it turns wary of someone (a sharper, quieter idle call); flee = the cry as it bolts; answer = a packmate answering a contact call, and a tame answering the whistle / Call your mount. A species' own row wins as soon as the voice pass adds it.

beds._comment: V1 the Ash Plains: wind over ash, the crater's far rumble.
V1: the crater's rumble under the wind.
V2 the Lava Fields: the river's gurgle and crack.
V3 the Obsidian Ridges: wind whistling on glass edges.
V4 the Solfatara: hiss and bubbling over the crust.
V5 the Crater Highlands: the crater's low roar.
T1 the Snow Flats: steady wind, snow hiss.
T2 the Pine Hollows: still air under the pines, a creaking trunk.
T3 the Frozen Lakes: wind over the lake ice.
T4 the Ice Shelves: ice groaning, meltwater.
T5 the Glacier Plateau: the katabatic howl.
The Desert everywhere: dry wind over sand, grains hissing off the crests (cooks/biome-desert.md 2.15).
By day: a far kite, sandgrouse calling as they fly to water.
The desert night: crickets in the scrub, the cold wind, a jackal's yip far off.
D1 the Wreck Strand: the surf on the west beach, the salt crust ticking in the heat.
D2 the Erg: wind streaming sand off the dune crests, the far boom of a slipface.
D3 the White Pan: near silence, a thin wind over the salt, the heat's ringing quiet.
D4 the Canyons: wind whistling in the slots, grit trickling down the walls.
D5 the Haboob Wall: the storm's roar and sand hiss (music low-passed under it, never muted).
The coast everywhere: surf on the bars and the reef, gulls far off (cooks/biome-ocean.md 2.15).
Gulls and terns over the strand by day.
The night shore: crickets in the dune grass, the surf's hush.
O1 the White Strand: long breakers on the bars, the swash running up the sand.
O2 the Blowhole Shelf: wind over the rock, the blowholes' distant booms.
O3 the Salt Terraces: dry wind over the pans, the ladles' clink.
O4 the Kelp Forest: lapping water, kelp creaking in the swell.
O5 the Reef and the Drop: heavy surf on the reef crest, open sea wind.
Under the surface: the sea's low hum and the far clicks (the Thalassor-sonar motif, faint), every other bed muffled.
F1 the Sinkhole Rim by day: sea wind over the plateau's moss (stand-in).
F1 by night: insects and the dolines' glow (stand-in).
F2 the Spore Gardens: drips in shafts of daylight (stand-in).
F3 the Glow-moss Halls: long, high, a long tail (stand-in).
F4 the Mycelium Webs: close, creaking, tight (stand-in).
F5 the Flooded Grottos: running water (stand-in).
The Heart Grotto: a warm hollow hum, the Heart pulse under it (stand-in).
The Flue's roar on the Fall Field: what its planned silence leaves (stand-in).
Wind over the islands, always (stand-in: high_wind); the aeolian harps' hum is the audio cook's.
Larks over the turf by day (stand-in).
Night on the islands: the wind dropping, a few insects (stand-in).
